model: Unweighted-mean ensemble of cross-subject decoders over the provided 4 s windows, each self-normalising on the 64-window prediction batch. Member families: Riemannian tangent space on band-limited covariances, xDAWN ERP covariances, low-frequency phase-locked time-domain logistic regression, feature-level fusions of these, and compact convolutional nets trained from scratch (EEGNet/ShallowConvNet/Deep4Net). Members selected on a subject-disjoint validation split. External pre-training data: Dreyer2023 (OSF 8tdk5, CC-BY-4.0). No pretrained model weights. AI-assisted, human-directed.

Ensemble of small CNNs over EEG windows plus a BIOT member; mean of top members selected on a clean validation split. Pretrained weights declared: braindecode/biot-pretrained-six-datasets-18chs (BSD-3-Clause). AI-assisted, human-directed.
